name: Training Up A Child
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital responsibility of parents to diligently teach and train their children in the ways of the Lord, as seen in Deuteronomy 6:7 where instruction is to be continual and purposeful. Children are described as a heritage from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), underscoring their value and the importance of godly upbringing. Proverbs stresses the necessity of timely discipline, warning that sparing the rod is harmful, while proper correction drives foolishness away (Proverbs 13:24; 19:18; 22:15). Ultimately, Proverbs 22:6 assures that training a child in the right way leads to lasting faithfulness in adulthood.
